value.text: One readout per frame. Numbers always mono. Nothing under 14px; planes get scaled down in 3D.
Black is transparent. Never use black or dark fills asa shape.
No panels or card grounds. Separation comes fromspace, not boxes.
Cyan is a budget: one live element at a time, under 5%of lit pixels.
Keep baked glow subtle. Blender bloom will multiplyit.
